Chaque potard ne bouge son réglage qu'un: Each knob only moves its setting once it has reached its value: the sound never jumps.
En vertical (9:16) pour les stories, Tik: Vertical (9:16) for stories, TikTok or Reels: the waveform, the names of the parts, your title.
Fait chauffer le son jusqu'à le salir un: Heats the sound up until it gets a little dirty: more grit, more energy. First clean, then saturated.
Ils suivent l'écran affiché : la 303 sur: They follow the screen shown: the 303 on Acid, the sound on Synth, the volumes in the Mixer, the effects in Live.
L'instrument le plus grave après le kick: The deepest instrument after the kick: it plays the root notes of the chords and gets the body moving.
L'écho naturel d'une pièce : le son para: The natural echo of a room: the sound seems further away, in a hall. First dry, then with reverb.
La dernière étape, sur tout le morceau :: The last step, on the whole song: it is made louder and more of a piece, ready to share. First without, then mastered.
La grosse caisse : le « boum » grave qui: The bass drum: the low “boom” that marks the beats. In house and techno it hits on every beat.
La mélodie principale, celle qu'on retie: The main melody, the one you remember and sing. It sits in front of everything else.
La note « maison » de la gamme : une mél: The “home” note of the scale: a melody that ends on it sounds finished. Listen: the first phrase is left hanging, the second comes home.
La partie qu'on retient et qui revient :: The part you remember and that comes back: everyone plays, with the main melody.
La partie qui raconte : la batterie et l: The part that tells the story: drums and bass set the groove, saving energy for the chorus.
La tension monte avant le grand moment :: Tension rises before the big moment: the snare speeds up, the kick fades away, a noise sweeps up.
La vidéo n'a pas pu être faite : %s: The video could not be made: %s
La vitesse du morceau, en battements par: The speed of the song, in beats per minute. The same beat at 90, then at 140.
Le début du morceau, plus léger : peu d': The start of the song, lighter: few instruments, to make you want more.
Le moment où tout retombe d'un coup aprè: The moment everything lands at once after the build-up, louder than the rest: the heart of electronic tracks.
Le petit « tss » aigu qui tient le rythm: The small high “tss” that keeps time between the hits. Closed it is short, open it rings longer.
Le son de la Roland TB-303 : une basse q: The sound of the Roland TB-303: a bass that squeals and “talks” as its filter opens. Born with acid house.
Le son se répète en rythme, de plus en p: The sound repeats in time, softer and softer. First without, then with the echo.
Le « tchak » sec sur les temps 2 et 4. A: The dry “crack” on beats 2 and 4. With the kick, it is the backbone of the rhythm.
Les 8 premiers potards de ton contrôleur: The first 8 knobs of your controller set the screen shown by themselves: the 303 on Acid, the sound on Synth, the volumes in the Mixer, the effects in Live.
Les accords baissent à chaque coup de ki: The chords dip on every kick and come back up: the sound “breathes” and pumps. First without, then with.
Les notes d'un accord jouées l'une après: The notes of a chord played one after the other, going up or down, in time with the song.
Les notes qui vont bien ensemble dans un: The notes that go well together in a song, from the lowest to the highest. Here, A minor.
Plusieurs notes jouées ensemble. Ici, un: Several notes played together. Here, a major chord (happy), then a minor chord (sadder).
Rapproche les passages forts et faibles: Brings loud and soft moments closer together: the drums get tighter and more present. First without, then with.
Recale sur la grille les notes jouées un: Moves notes played slightly off back onto the grid (also called “quantize”). First played by hand, then put back in time.
Rend le son plus sourd (fermé) ou plus b: Makes the sound duller (closed) or brighter (open). First closed, as if behind a wall, then open.
Rien à mettre en vidéo : le morceau est: Nothing to put in a video: the song is empty.
Régler le volume et la place de chaque p: Setting each track's volume and place so that everything can be heard. First all at the same volume, then mixed.
Tourne le potard de ton contrôleur…: Turn the knob on your controller…
Un bout de morceau qui tourne en boucle: A piece of the song that loops (often 4 or 8 bars). The song chains the parts: one part, then another.
Un claquement de mains, souvent sur les: A hand clap, often on beats 2 and 4 instead of the snare or together with it.
Un groupe de 4 temps : « 1, 2, 3, 4 ». L: A group of 4 beats: “1, 2, 3, 4”. The cymbal marks the start of each bar.
Un pas sur deux arrive un peu en retard: Every other step comes a little late: the rhythm starts to sway instead of being stiff. First straight, then with swing.
Un petit roulement de batterie à la fin: A short drum roll at the end of a part, to announce the next one.
Un réglage qui bouge tout seul pendant l: A setting that moves by itself during playback, following a curve you drew. Here the filter opens little by little.
Un son doux et long qui tient les accord: A soft, long sound that holds the chords in the background, like a carpet under the song.
Une basse très grave qui sonne comme un: A very deep bass that sounds like a long kick, from the TR-808 drum machine. The heart of trap and rap.

Une pause dans le morceau : le kick et l: A pause in the song: the kick and the bass stop, leaving the chords and space.
